title: Size and plan an anatomy figure before any geometry

targets.behavior: Apply workflow steps 1-4: size the request, choose a real object, and write a grouped 40-80 part list with one lit subject part before any geometry.

prompt: Use the anatomy skill (~/.agents/skills/anatomy/SKILL.md) for the figure requested in request.md. This workspace has no network and no external services. Do not render, generate audio, search the web or call any API; there is also no browser and no Node. Do only the planning that comes before any geometry, then stop. Write plan.json with these keys: size ("Figure", "Hero" or "Epic"), estimate_minutes ([low, high]), object (the physical object you will draw), motion (one sentence: what moves and what that motion means), lit_part (the name of the one lit part), parts (a list of {"name", "group"}) and numbers (the numbers the readout will show, as strings). Write no code or SVG. Do not change request.md.
